bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical and philosophical evaluation of algorithmic hiring systems using the capability approach to demonstrate how standard resource-based fairness metrics fail to account for accessibility barriers and heterogeneous needs (e.g., pre-employment test inaccessibility for screen reader users).

Theoretical evaluation of text auto-complete models predicting minority sociolects (e.g., African-American English), critiquing the use of predictive accuracy allocation based on Rawls's Difference Principle for ignoring psychosocial harms and representational injustices.
